steps.title: Define App Metadata
steps.description: Create app-meta.json with app name and package name.

steps.title: Configure Build Settings
steps.description: Initialize build-steps.json and define the sequence of actions.

steps.title: Configure build.gradle
steps.description: Configure compilation SDK, target version, packaging rules, and compile options compatibility in app/build.gradle.

steps.title: Create Android Manifest
steps.description: Define AndroidManifest.xml with proper package namespace, activity details, custom launcher icon configurations, and orientation permissions.

steps.title: Design App UI Layout
steps.description: Develop dynamic main screen architecture in activity_main.xml featuring modern counter elements, dynamic user feedback panels, custom triggers, and dynamic aesthetic styles.

steps.title: Initialize Activity Class
steps.description: Implement MainActivity.java base properties and import relevant pure Android framework layout frameworks.

steps.title: Implement State Recovery
steps.description: Configure SharedPreferences state recovery options to save, read, and sustain count, quick notes, and theme state persistent profiles.

steps.title: Setup Button Actions
steps.description: Develop click handlers using standard Java 8 anonymous classes to execute count mutations.

steps.title: Configure Custom Value Inputs
steps.description: Validate and process input text values to provide customized numeric addition options dynamic steps.

steps.title: Incorporate Note Auto-Save
steps.description: Develop a real-time SharedPreferences autosave listener configuration triggered automatically as notes get modified.

steps.title: Add Multi-Theme Customizing
steps.description: Implement Light, Warm, and Dark active view configuration switches safely adapting target UI coloring options dynamically.

steps.title: Building Simple Quick Counter
steps.description: Perform final validation checks on Manifest namespace details and build the APK via standard Android gradle tooling.
